units.source_text: 无论哪户的门口，旁边都开了暗色的格子富，都是二层楼房。

en.t: At the entrance of every house, there was a dark lattice window to the side, and all of them were two-story buildings.

units.source_text: 古老而沉重的瓦屋顶，都是一般高地排列在陕俄的月光下。

en.t: Their old, heavy tiled roofs were lined up at the same height beneath the narrow moonlight.

units.source_text: 家家门口都挂着印有"西阵"白字样的蓝布帘，身着白罩衣的老鸨母侧身从门帘的一头窥视着外面。

en.t: At every doorway hung a blue curtain printed with the white characters "Nishijin," and an old madam in a white smock leaned sideways to peer out from one end of the curtain.
